name: 195-version-probe-no-attestation
note: #195: the standard launch (pluginRoot, no probeRunPath) with the plugin hooks disabled. The plugin version probe is the first probe, so it is the one whose attestation is missing. The cause is the hooks, not the plugin root: the run ends as the documented provision-failed with probeReason no-attestation, and never says to pass the current plugin root.

args.brief: a probe that was never attested must not be reported as an unreadable plugin version
